question: 2025年实际产量最高的月份产量是多少

fixture.sql: SELECT MAX(monthly.amount) FROM (SELECT SUM(actual_qty) AS amount FROM fact_production_order JOIN dim_work_center ON fact_production_order.work_center_id = dim_work_center.work_center_id WHERE fact_production_order.is_deleted = 0 AND fact_production_order.period LIKE '2025%' AND fact_production_order.actual_qty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fact_production_order.period) AS monthly
